description: Contract dataset for Schemaport 0.1.0. Covers the Anthropic Messages API and the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs: tool-definition contracts, the strict schema subsets and their limits, and prompt-cache prefix shape.
evidence_position: Every record is transcribed from the provider's own published documentation and cites the page and section it came from, at confidence 'documented', or is a heuristic built on a documented mechanism and marked 'experimental' with the inference stated. There are no records at confidence 'observed': that level requires a reproducible probe against a live endpoint, and this release ships none. See docs/contract-data.md for what each level licenses.
